summary: CL Workshop Group Limited, a BVI-incorporated, Macau-based forestry and wood products issuer listed via Form 6-K, furnished interim results rather than a special situation. The October 6, 2026 report attaches management's discussion and analysis (Exhibit 99.1) and unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements (Exhibit 99.2) for the six months ended June 30, 2026 and 2025, signed by Director and CEO Liying Wang. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock is stated; the disclosure is incorporated by reference into the company's Form F-3 and S-8 registration statements. Watch for operational updates on Peru downsizing, cost controls, and China, France, US, and South Asia demand.
